scientific_integrity: The algebraic proof uses an explicit positive semidefinite Gram matrix, an exact four-dimensional quotient characteristic polynomial, and a global group-averaging argument. The bundled symbolic and finite checks are supplementary. Source-date provenance is the dated original September 2, 2005 preprint, not a later journal issue.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimum above q=p+2 is not determined; only strict nonattainment of B/(p+4) is proved. Unrestricted uniqueness is not asserted. Results apply to p>=4; the p=3,q=2 counterexample shows that restriction is substantive. Specialized prior treatments may exist; Kirkland–Pati 2002 was available only by abstract.
title: Sharp conductance-budget plateau for a pendant complete bipartite network
